versions.changelog: V1.1: Added semantic search, hybrid scoring, and AI-powered task matching. Uses local char n-gram embeddings (384d). Hybrid search combines keyword (BM25-style) and semantic scores 50/50. New suggest command with confidence ratings (High/Medium/Low). Enhanced keyword scoring: exact match +20, name contains +10, triggers +3.
Initial release: search available skills without loading them all into context
